trialLines.text: During the trial you get temporary access to the Scale tier.
The 7-day trial is enabled from the CRM (crm.pawwerapp.com). This site does not capture or store card data.
Billing will be enabled through a hosted Stripe or Mercado Pago checkout when the integration is active.
You can cancel your subscription at any time from the CRM. If you cancel before the 7 days end, no charge is made.
Tax, proration and credit renewal conditions: to be confirmed with PAWWER.
